'''Galen''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
===Cold War===
====Early career and the Planet Prison====
A [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Galen became an agent in the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]]&mdash;the primary intelligence agency of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Around [[3643 BBY]], he was stationed on the Republic capital of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and headed the SIS base in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Tower]].
When the design files for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] were stolen by a team of thieves, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] placed Galen and his team in charge of the investigation. Galen coordinated his search efforts with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]], but the SIS agent led the investigation and reported directly to General Suthra.

Galen's investigation soon proved fruitful, as his agents were able to identify one of the thieves from a security recording&mdash; a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named [[Vistis Garn]]. Galen then went straight to Suthra, who was speaking with the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and [[Orgus Din]], Orgus' [[Hero of Tython|former Padawan]], Kiwiiks' current [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Kira Carsen]], and [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Eli Tarnis]], the creator of the Planet Prison. Learning that Galen had a lead, Din ordered his former Padawan&mdash;now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]&mdash;to work directly with Galen, while the Jedi Masters and Suthra went to speak with the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]]. Kiwiiks also suggested that Carsen remain behind, as her security expertise could prove useful. Galen then explained his lead to the two young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and Doctor Tarnis: Garn, who was known to work with the criminal [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]], had recently been spotted raiding a military warehouse for high-grade munitions and weapons.

The Knight and the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] headed to the Guild-controlled [[Old Galactic Market]] to recover the weapons and design files, while Galen remained at the Senate Tower and worked with Carsen to distract the criminals with Coruscant's security network. However, while the Knight and T7 were successfully [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recovering the stolen files and weapons]], Galen and Carsen encountered a security breach. Somehow, members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate infiltrated the Senate Tower's security and kidnapped Doctor Tarnis right under the SIS's noses. When the Knight contacted Galen to report success, the agent brusquely ordered the Jedi back to the Senate Tower to aid in the search for Tarnis. Galen was disturbed to learn that Garn had been in fact hired by Black Sun to steal the files in the first place, and handed the recovered files off to his subordinate [[Krand]] for decryption

Just as Galen was explaining the situation to the Knight, he received a holocall from Carsen, who had pursued the kidnappers to the [[Coruscant Spaceport|nearby spaceport]] with CSF forces. She and the security team had pinned down the kidnappers in [[Docking Bay 84]], but they were unable to make any more progress. Galen ordered the Knight to go aid Carsen, and together the two Jedi were able to defeat the Black Sun members and discover that Tarnis had been taken to [[Black Sun territory]].

Tracking the Black Sun operatives who had supposedly kidnapped Doctor Tarnis,<ref name="SWTORKidnapped" /> the Jedi Knight discovered that Tarnis was in fact a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and the son of [[Darth Angral]]. With this revelation all of the Republic's superweapon projects were in danger.<ref name="SWTORRescue">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Rescue|Coruscant}}</ref> Galen left Coruscant shortly after that to secure the [[Power Guard Enhancement System]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="SWTORgalensearch" />

{{GameLS}}
====Power Guard project====
{{Quote|<nowiki>Agent Galen = changed // 68.3 percent biological mass - replaced by cybernetics + other synthetic materials</nowiki>|translated=1|[[T7-O1]] on Galen's transformation|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Galenpowerguard.png|thumb|left|150px|Galen became a Power Guard for the rest of his life]]
As soon as he settled down on Nar Shaddaa and began his work, Galen was captured by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Lord [[Sadic]]. Sadic then turned Galen into a [[Mark III Power Guard]] and forced Galen to obey his commands by punishing him with extreme pain if he refused. In a final act of defiance, Galen turned on Sadic and the other Power Guards. However, they were too powerful and Galen was severely wounded.<ref name="SWTORsadicshow" /> Galen would survive, however, and learned how to control his implants with help from the SIS. Using his new abilities, Galen would go deep undercover into Sith space. He contacted the Knight who had saved him and told them about his assignment, thanking the Jedi for showing Galen that he still had something to live for.<ref name="Message">{{TORcite|Message to the Jedi Knight}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
Galen was a competent and dedicated SIS agent. He was determined to protect the Republic at all costs, including his life.

However, his personality drastically changed after being transformed into a Power Guard. He became miserable and depressed not only due to being Sadic's slave, but also because of his unwilling transformation. Even with Sadic gone, he still preferred to die rather than live like a machine, even willing to go as far as commit suicide. However, he still retained some humanity and loyalty, as he helped the Hero of Tython defeat Sadic. When Sadic was defeated, he preferred to stay and die, but when the SIS urged him to come along he obliged.

Afterwards, Galen would learn to control his implants, and accept his condition. He would later send a message to the Jedi, thanking them for showing him that he still had something to live for.<ref name="SWTORsadicshow" />

==Behind the scenes==
Galen first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the main story quests for the Jedi Knight story arc. At the end for the dark side option, when Galen is a Power Guard cyborg, the Republic player can choose to kill him instead of letting him live and letting him sacrifice himself.
